newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn firms but soybeans slip.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn firms but soybeans slip.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn offers rose one to two cents a bushel in the January and February positions while soybeans fell two to three cents spurred by heavy movement, export sources said. Wheat values were flat.
Dealers were watching the harsh weather and how it will affect the movement of grain via the Mississippi and Illinois Rivers and rail in parts of the Midwest, one exporter said.

"That is why it is a little bit higher in nearby corn and easier in the deferreds." As CBOT soybeans soared on Friday, farmers began to actively sell beans, taking advantage of the rally, the exporter added.
